name: audit-a-truncated-strain-model
turns: The P. falciparum Dd2 gene PfDd2_140076300 (YIP1) gives a shorter protein than the 3D7 gene PF3D7_1472100. Is the Dd2 gene model right?
rationale: A positive of the answer key: the Dd2 model lacks a part of the protein its genome encodes. The audit keeps the error on the Dd2 gene and names the truncation as its cause.
